items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Theal had something to do with it, I don't know, maybe picking up the tab or something. I seem to feel his presence somewhere behind there, but I can't pinpoint it.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, Commodore got the tape. It was done -- either -- I'm not sure if it was solo art or - yes, solo art did it. Theal had something to do with it, I don't know, maybe picking up the tab or something. I seem to feel his presence somewhere behind there, but I can't pinpoint it. My memory does not serve me that well, as regards that.

But I did get that date because of George not being able to make it. And the time was paid for, the studio was paid for. And I was ready. They called me, I came in and I made ten three-minute tunes. And I still got the tracks at home somewhere. I'm not crazy about many of them. But Selections from the Gutter was one of them.
